name: local-api-mcp-typescript

tools.name: open-browser
tools.description: Start an existing AdsPower browser profile (launch the profile browser). / 启动已存在的 AdsPower 浏览器环境（用户常称环境、配置文件、profile）。 | Triggers: open browser, launch profile, start environment, open AdsPower, open config profile; 打开浏览器,启动环境,打开配置,打开配置文件,打开profile,拉起AdsPower,启动指纹浏览器

profile_no.description: Profile serial number (environment number). At least one of profile_id or profile_no is required; if both are provided, profile_id takes priority (AdsPower API).

profile_id.description: Unique profile ID generated after creating a profile; identifies which browser to open. At least one of profile_id or profile_no is required; if both are provided, profile_id takes priority (AdsPower API).

ip_tab.description: The ip tab of the browser, 0 is not use ip tab, 1 is use ip tab, default is 0

launch_args.description: The launch args of the browser, use chrome launch args, eg: ["--window-position=400,0","--blink-settings=imagesEnabled=false", "--disable-notifications"]

headless.description: Headless: "0" visible window, "1" headless. If omitted, the runtime may auto-set "1" when no graphical session is detected (Linux without DISPLAY/WAYLAND, or CI). Explicit "0"/"1" is always sent as-is.

last_opened_tabs.description: Whether to restore the last opened tabs.

delete_cache.description: The clear cache after closing of the browser, 0 is not clear cache after closing, 1 is clear cache after closing, default is 0

cdp_mask.description: The cdp mask of the browser, 0 is not use cdp mask, 1 is use cdp mask, default is 0

device_scale.description: Device scale factor passed to browser-profile/start.

tools.name: close-browser
tools.description: Stop a running AdsPower browser profile. / 关闭正在运行的浏览器环境 / profile。 | Triggers: close browser, stop profile, shutdown environment, kill browser; 关闭浏览器,停止环境,关掉profile,结束浏览器,退出指纹环境

profile_id.description: The profile id of the browser to stop, either profile_id or profile_no must be provided

profile_no.description: The profile number of the browser to stop, priority will be given to profile_id when profile_id is filled

tools.name: create-browser
tools.description: Create a new AdsPower browser profile (account). / 新建浏览器环境 / 账号 profile。 | Triggers: create profile, new browser, add account, spin up profile; 新建环境,创建profile,添加浏览器,新开指纹,创建账号

group_id.description: The group id of the browser, must be a numeric string (e.g., "123"). You can use the get-group-list tool to get the group list or create a new group, use 0 for Ungrouped

cookie.description: Cookie data in JSON array string or Netscape format, eg: '[{"domain":".baidu.com","expirationDate":1724188800,"name":"BAIDUID","value":"xxxxxxxxxx"}]'

platform.description: Platform domain, eg: facebook.com, The platform account is only applicable to single account platform settings. If you need to configure multiple account platforms, please use platform_account instead.

remark.description: Remarks to describe the profile. Maximum 1500 characters.

user_proxy_config.description: Proxy configuration. If proxyid is provided, proxyid takes priority and this field is ignored. Defaults to no_proxy when neither proxyid nor a custom proxy is needed.

proxy_soft.description: The proxy soft of the browser

proxy_host.description: The proxy host of the browser, eg: 127.0.0.1

proxy_port.description: The proxy port of the browser, eg: 8080

proxy_user.description: The proxy user for proxy authentication, eg: user

proxy_password.description: The proxy password for proxy authentication, eg: password

proxy_url.description: This URL is used for dynamic proxy, only supports http/https/socks5 proxies. 1. By clicking this link, you can manually change the proxy IP address. 2. When multiple environments use the same proxy account, refreshing the IP will change the IP address of the same proxy account.

global_config.description: The global config of the browser, default is 0

proxyid.description: Already added proxy (proxy ID). user_proxy_config and proxyid cannot be empty at the same time. Takes priority over user_proxy_config when provided.

repeat_config.description: Account deduplication settings (0, 2, 3, or 4), 0: allow duplicate (default), 2: deduplicate by account and password, 3: deduplicate by cookie, 4: deduplicate by c_user (c_user is Facebook's unique identifier)

ignore_cookie_error.description: Handle cookie verification failures: 0 (default) return data as-is, 1 filter out incorrectly formatted cookies

tabs.description: URLs to open on startup, eg: ["https://www.google.com"]

category_id.description: The category id of the browser, you can use the get-application-list tool to get the application list

profile_tag_ids.description: Tag IDs to assign to the profile, max 30 tags per profile. Example: ["tag1","tag2"]

fingerprint_config.description: Fingerprint config (fingerprint_config). All fields optional. See AdsPower Local API fingerprint_config.

automatic_timezone.description: Auto timezone by IP: 0 custom, 1 (default) by IP

location_switch.description: 1: Generate location based on IP (default); 0: Specify location

longitude.description: Custom longitude when location_switch=0, -180 to 180, up to 6 decimals

latitude.description: Custom latitude when location_switch=0, -90 to 90, up to 6 decimals

accuracy.description: Location accuracy in meters when location_switch=0, 10-5000, default 1000

location.description: When the website requests to obtain your current location, the support: ask (default), allow, block; ask: ask (default), the same as the prompt of ordinary browsers; allow: always allow the website to get the location; block: always block the website from getting the location.

language_switch.description: Language by IP country: 0 custom, 1 (default) by IP

page_language_switch.description: Match UI language to language: 0 off, 1 (default) on; Chrome 109+ Win / 119+ macOS, v2.6.72+

page_language.description: Page language when page_language_switch=0, e.g. en-US

ua.description: Custom User-Agent string; when set, takes precedence over random_ua (random_ua is not sent). Omit for random UA.

screen_resolution.description: Screen resolution: none (default), random, or width_height e.g. 1024_600

fonts.description: Font list e.g. ["Arial", "Times New Roman"] or ["all"]

canvas.description: Canvas fingerprint: 0 computer default, 1 (default) add noise

webgl.description: WebGL metadata: 0 computer default, 2 custom (use webgl_config), 3 random

webgl_image.description: WebGL image fingerprint: 0 default, 1 (default) add noise

webgl_config.description: Custom WebGL metadata when webgl=2. Must include unmasked_vendor and unmasked_renderer (non-empty). webgpu.webgpu_switch: 0 Disabled, 1 WebGL based, 2 Real. V2.6.8.1+

unmasked_vendor.description: WebGL vendor string, e.g. "Google Inc.". Required when webgl=2, cannot be empty.

unmasked_renderer.description: WebGL renderer string, e.g. "ANGLE (Intel(R) HD Graphics 620 Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0)". Required when webgl=2, cannot be empty.

webrtc.description: WebRTC: forward: forward, use proxy IP to cover real IP, used in proxy scene, more secure (need to upgrade to V2.6.8.6 or later version); proxy: replace, use proxy IP to cover real IP, used in proxy scene; local: real, the website will get the real IP; disabled: disabled (default), the website will not get the IP; disableUDP: disable UDP, disable non-proxy UDP traffic (only supported by Chrome kernel).

do_not_track.description: Do Not Track: default, true (open), false (close)

hardware_concurrency.description: CPU cores: default(follow computer actual CPU cores), 2, 4 (default if omitted), 6, 8, 16; omit to follow current computer

device_memory.description: Device memory (GB): default(follow computer actual device memory), 2, 4, 6, 8 (default if omitted); omit to follow current computer

allow_scan_ports.description: Ports allowed when scan_port_type=1, e.g. ["4000","4001"]. Empty to not pass.

media_devices.description: Media devices: 0 off (use computer default), 1 noise (count follows local), 2 noise (use media_devices_num). V2.6.4.2+

media_devices_num.description: When media_devices=2: audioinput_num, videoinput_num, audiooutput_num each 1-9. V2.6.4.2+

client_rects.description: ClientRects: 0 use computer default, 1 add noise. V3.6.2+

device_name_switch.description: Device name: 0 close (use computer name), 1 mask, 2 custom (use device_name). V3.6.25+

device_name.description: Custom device name when device_name_switch=2. V2.4.8.1+

speech_switch.description: SpeechVoices: 0 use computer default, 1 replace with value. V3.11.10+

mac_address_config.description: MAC address: model 0/1/2, address when model=2. V4.3.9+

model.description: 0: use current computer MAC, 1: match appropriate value, 2: custom (address required)

address.description: Custom MAC address when model=2, e.g. "E4-02-9B-3B-E9-27"

gpu.description: GPU: 0 follow Local settings - Hardware acceleration, 1 turn on, 2 turn off

browser_kernel_config.description: The browser kernel config of the browser, default is version: ua_auto, type: chrome

version.description: The version of the browser, must match type: chrome 92–143 or ua_auto, firefox 100,107,114,120,123,126,129,132,135,138,141,144 or ua_auto; default is ua_auto

type.description: The type of the browser, default is chrome

random_ua.description: Random UA config; ignored when ua (custom UA) is provided.

ua_system_version.description: UA system version. Mac OS X / Windows / iOS / Android / Linux = random any version of that system; omit to random across all systems. e.g. ["Android 9", "iOS 14"] or ["Android", "Mac OS X"]

tls.description: TLS cipher list when tls_switch=1: comma-separated hex codes. Chrome kernel only.

platform_account.description: Structured platform account metadata keyed by Postman field name platform_account.

login_user.description: Platform login user, e.g. shop username or login email

tools.name: update-browser
tools.description: Update fields of an existing browser profile. / 更新已有 profile 的配置（备注、代理、指纹等）。 | Triggers: edit profile, change settings, modify browser, update fingerprint; 修改配置,更新profile,改代理,改指纹,编辑环境

platform.description: The platform of the browser, eg: facebook.com

tabs.description: The tabs of the browser, eg: ["https://www.google.com"]

cookie.description: Cookie data in JSON array string or Netscape format, eg: '[{"domain":".baidu.com","expirationDate":1724188800,"name":"BAIDUID","value":"xxxxxxxxxx"}]'

username.description: The username of the browser, eg: "user"

password.description: The password of the browser, eg: "password"

ignore_cookie_error.description: Specifies how to handle the case when cookie validation fails.

group_id.description: The group id of the browser, must be a numeric string (e.g., "123"). You can use the get-group-list tool to get the group list or create a new group

name.description: The Profile name of the browser, eg: "My Browser"

country.description: The country of the browser, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (lowercase). eg: "cn", "us"

category_id.description: The category id of the browser, you can use the get-application-list tool to get the application list

proxy_soft.description: The proxy soft of the browser

proxy_port.description: The proxy port of the browser, eg: 8080

tls.description: TLS cipher list when tls_switch=1: comma-separated hex codes. Chrome kernel only.

profile_tag_ids.description: Tag IDs to set on the profile, max 30 tags per profile. Example: ["tag1","tag2"]

tags_update_type.description: How to apply profile_tag_ids: "1" (default) replace all existing tags; "2" append tags (truncated to 30 total if exceeded)

profile_id.description: The profile id of the browser to update, it is required when you want to update the browser

platform_account.description: Structured platform account metadata keyed by Postman field name platform_account.

login_user.description: Platform login user, e.g. shop username or login email

tools.name: delete-browser
tools.description: Delete one or more browser profiles permanently. / 永久删除一个或多个浏览器 profile。 | Triggers: remove profile, delete account, trash browser; 删除环境,移除profile,删掉浏览器账号

profile_id.description: The profile ids of the browsers to delete, it is required when you want to delete the browser

tools.name: get-recycle-bin-list
tools.description: List browser profiles in the recycle bin from the last 30 days. / 查询近 30 天回收站中的浏览器环境。 | Triggers: recycle bin, deleted profiles, trash list, recently deleted; 回收站,已删除环境,最近删除,垃圾桶列表

page.description: Page number. Omit to use the Local API backend default. Only profiles deleted in the last 30 days and visible to the caller are returned.

limit.description: Profiles per page, range 1-100. Omit to use the Local API backend default.

tools.name: restore-recycle-bin
tools.description: Restore one or more deleted browser profiles from the recycle bin into a target group. / 把回收站里的一个或多个环境恢复到指定分组。 | Triggers: restore profile, recover deleted browser, undelete environment; 恢复环境,还原回收站,找回已删除环境

profile_id.description: Array of one or more profile IDs in the recycle bin. Either profile_id or profile_no is required. If both are provided, profile_id takes priority.

profile_no.description: Array of one or more profile serial numbers in the recycle bin. Either profile_id or profile_no is required. If both are provided, profile_id takes priority.

group_id.description: Target group ID after restore. Use get-group-list to find a group the caller can use. "0" is ungrouped.

tools.name: get-browser-list
tools.description: List or search browser profiles (pagination, filters). / 分页/条件查询浏览器 profile 列表。 | Triggers: list profiles, search browsers, query accounts, show all profiles; 列表,查询环境,搜索profile,列出所有浏览器

group_id.description: Query by group ID; searches all groups if empty

limit.description: Profiles per page, range 1 ~ 200. If omitted the CLI sends limit=200; the Local API itself defaults to only 1, so always rely on this CLI default or pass an explicit value

page.description: Page number for results. If omitted the CLI sends page=1

sort_type.description: Sort results by: profile_no, last_open_time, or created_time

tag_ids.description: Tag IDs to filter profiles by tags. Example: ["tag1","tag2"]

tags_filter.description: Tag matching mode: "include" (default) matches profiles with any of the tags, "exclude" matches profiles without the tags

name.description: Profile name keyword to search for

name_filter.description: Name matching mode: "include" (default) matches profiles containing the name keyword, "exclude" matches profiles not containing the name keyword

tools.name: get-opened-browser
tools.description: List browser profiles currently open on this device. / 查看本机当前已打开的浏览器 profile。 | Triggers: opened browsers, running profiles, active local sessions; 已打开,正在运行,当前会话,本地活跃

tools.name: move-browser
tools.description: Move profiles to another group (regroup). / 将 profile 移动到指定分组。 | Triggers: move to group, regroup profiles, change group; 移动分组,换组,归类到组

group_id.description: The target group id, must be a numeric string (e.g., "123"). You can use the get-group-list tool to get the group list

user_ids.description: The browser Profile ids to move

tools.name: get-profile-cookies
tools.description: Read cookies for one profile. / 读取单个 profile 的 Cookie。 | Triggers: get cookies, export cookies, read cookie jar; 导出Cookie,查看Cookie,读取站点Cookie

profile_id.description: The profile id, either profile_id or profile_no must be provided

profile_no.description: The profile number, priority will be given to profile_id when profile_id is filled

tools.name: get-profile-ua
tools.description: Get User-Agent strings for up to 10 profiles. / 批量查询最多 10 个 profile 的 UA。 | Triggers: user agent, UA string, browser UA; UA,用户代理,浏览器标识

profile_id.description: The profile id array, either profile_id or profile_no must be provided

profile_no.description: The profile number array, priority will be given to profile_id when profile_id is filled

tools.name: close-all-profiles
tools.description: Close all opened profiles on this device. / 关闭本机所有已打开的环境。 | Triggers: close everything, stop all browsers, shutdown all profiles; 全部关闭,一键关环境,关所有浏览器

tools.name: new-fingerprint
tools.description: Generate a new fingerprint for up to 10 profiles. / 为最多 10 个 profile 重新生成指纹。 | Triggers: refresh fingerprint, regenerate fp, new device identity; 刷新指纹,重新指纹,换设备指纹

profile_id.description: The profile id array, either profile_id or profile_no must be provided

profile_no.description: The profile number array, priority will be given to profile_id when profile_id is filled

tools.name: delete-cache-v2
tools.description: Clear selected local cache types for profiles. / 按类型清理 profile 本地缓存。 | Triggers: clear cache, wipe storage, delete history cache; 清缓存,删历史,清理本地数据

profile_id.description: The profile ids array, it is required

type.description: Types of cache to clear, it is required

tools.name: share-profile
tools.description: Share profiles to another AdsPower account. / 将 profile 分享给其他 AdsPower 账号。 | Triggers: share account, transfer profile, send browser to user; 分享环境,转让profile,发给同事

profile_id.description: The profile ids array, it is required

receiver.description: Receiver's account email or phone number (no area code), it is required

share_type.description: Share type: 1 for email (default), 2 for phone number

tools.name: get-browser-active
tools.description: Get active status/details for one profile. / 查询单个 profile 的活跃/运行信息。 | Triggers: is profile running, active status, browser state; 是否在线,活跃状态,运行信息

profile_id.description: The profile id, either profile_id or profile_no must be provided

profile_no.description: The profile number, priority will be given to profile_id when profile_id is filled

tools.name: get-cloud-active
tools.description: Query cloud-side active status for many profile IDs. / 按 user_ids 批量查询云端活跃状态。 | Triggers: cloud status, remote active, team multi device caveat; 云端状态,远程是否打开,多设备模式限制

user_ids.description: Profile IDs string to check (split by comma, max 100 per request). Unique profile ID, generated after creating the profile.

tools.name: create-group
tools.description: Create a browser profile group. / 新建浏览器分组。 | Triggers: new group, add folder for profiles; 新建分组,创建组,环境分组

group_name.description: The name of the group to create

tools.name: update-group
tools.description: Rename or update a group. / 重命名或更新分组信息。 | Triggers: rename group, edit group; 改组名,更新分组

group_id.description: The id of the group to update, must be a numeric string (e.g., "123"). You can use the get-group-list tool to get the group list

group_name.description: The new name of the group

remark.description: The new remark of the group

tools.name: get-group-list
tools.description: List groups with optional name search. / 分页查询分组列表，可按名称搜索。 | Triggers: list groups, search group name; 分组列表,查组名

group_name.description: The name of the group to search, use like to search

page_size.description: The size of the page, max is 100, default is 10

page.description: The page of the group, default is 1

tools.name: create-member
tools.description: Create a team member (admin / manager / staff). / 新建团队成员（管理员 / 经理 / 员工）。 | Triggers: create member, add user, invite teammate, new staff; 创建成员,添加用户,邀请同事,新建员工

user_group_id.description: Member group / role id. Use get-member-group-list to obtain it

password.description: Login password in plaintext, 8 to 50 characters. The Local API hashes it before storing

manager.description: Direct manager user_id. Optional even when identity is 4 (staff); omit for no manager. Only staff may send this field

member.description: Direct subordinate user_id list, max 300. Only for identity 3 (manager). Do not send for admin (2); the Local API will reject it

authorized_group.description: Authorized browser group ids, max 1500. Empty array means no groups

tools.name: update-member
tools.description: Update an existing team member (role, groups, profile limit). / 编辑已有团队成员（身份、授权分组、环境额度等）。 | Triggers: edit member, change role, update staff, authorized group; 编辑成员,改身份,更新用户,授权分组

name.description: Member display name, max 50 characters. Empty string clears the name. Omit to keep unchanged

email.description: Member email, max 70 characters. Omit to keep unchanged. Do not send empty string; it will fail validation

identity.description: Role type: 2 admin, 3 manager, 4 staff. Omit to keep unchanged. Do not send empty; it will fail validation

manager.description: Direct manager user_id. Empty string clears the manager. Omit to keep unchanged. Only staff may send this field

member.description: Direct subordinate user_id list, max 300. Only for identity 3 (manager). Empty array clears subordinates. Do not send for admin (2)

authorized_group.description: Authorized browser group ids, max 1500. Omit to keep current groups. Empty array plus group_update_type 1 (default) replaces/clears; 2 appends/keeps

group_update_type.description: How authorized_group is applied: 1 replace (default), 2 append

remark.description: Remark, max 100 characters. Empty string clears the remark. Omit to keep unchanged

tools.name: reset-member-password
tools.description: Reset a team member password; new_password is returned in the response. / 重置成员密码，成功响应里返回明文 new_password。 | Triggers: reset password, new password, unbind phone; 重置密码,改密码,解绑手机

user_id.description: Member user_id whose password will be reset
